shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rounded boulder/monument face
curvilinear glyph-like or emblematic motifs with rounded rectangular cartouches
stacked or superimposed motifs filling the upper and lower halves of the surface
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief carving on a rounded stone face composed of rounded-cornered cartouches, hooked scrolls and curvilinear glyph-like signs stacked in registers over the upper part of the block, which is a fairly specific shared convention. However, A reads as an orderly grid of repeated blocky sign-cartouches with no discernible creature, while B is dominated by a single large zoomorphic/masklike head with eye, snout and volutes below smaller elements, so the specific subject differs.
